availability_entries_available_times_chk.name: availability_entries_available_times_chk
availability_entries_available_times_chk.value: "availability_entries"."kind" != 'available' OR ("availability_entries"."start_minutes" IS NOT NULL AND "availability_entries"."end_minutes" IS NOT NULL AND "availability_entries"."start_minutes" >= 0 AND "availability_entries"."start_minutes" < 1440 AND "availability_entries"."end_minutes" > "availability_entries"."start_minutes" AND "availability_entries"."end_minutes" <= "availability_entries"."start_minutes" + 1440)

availability_entries_day_off_times_chk.name: availability_entries_day_off_times_chk
availability_entries_day_off_times_chk.value: "availability_entries"."kind" != 'day_off' OR ("availability_entries"."start_minutes" IS NULL AND "availability_entries"."end_minutes" IS NULL)

orders_closed_status_has_closed_at_chk.name: orders_closed_status_has_closed_at_chk
orders_closed_status_has_closed_at_chk.value: "orders"."status" NOT IN ('paid', 'cancelled') OR "orders"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL

payments_void_has_reason_chk.name: payments_void_has_reason_chk
payments_void_has_reason_chk.value: "payments"."voided_at" IS NULL OR "payments"."void_reason" IS NOT NULL
